problems_addressed.specific_problem: Generating leads with a small YouTube following

episode_summary: In this episode, Sam Burke shares his journey from a young real estate agent to a top producer, emphasizing the importance of maintaining high service standards and leveraging YouTube for lead generation. He discusses his investment strategies and offers actionable insights on building relationships and using social media effectively.
